newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis down, soybeans steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn basis down, soybeans steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values dropped one to two cents per bushel Monday in nearby positions in reaction to greater barge movement on the U.S. river systems, grain dealers said.
Soybean and winter wheat basis values were mostly unchanged.
Milder weather in the Midwest has broken up ice blockages on rivers allowing for an increase in barge traffic. Barge freight rates also have been decreasing, dealers said.
One dealer said corn with higher-than-preferred moisture has been reported in export channels.
Exporters are carefully monitoring arrivals at the Gulf to ensure the moisture meets contract specifications, the dealer said.
